ruleDefinitions.name: Potential PendingFileRenameOperations Tampering
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect changes to the "PendingFileRenameOperations" registry key from uncommon or suspicious images locations to stage currently used files for rename or deletion after reboot.

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\Session\\ Manager\\\\PendingFileRenameOperations.*") AND ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regedit\\\.exe$")))
